source: Public App Store data only: listing (it), release notes 10.0-10.1, 4 screenshots, 31 reviews of 1-3 stars. Written by hand on 2026-10-14 (Tools/spec.py had no API key).

features.name: Torch, front/back camera, zoom
features.reason: Screenshot 1 toolbar: flash and camera switch. Pinch to zoom.

features.name: Scan from a photo
features.reason: Screenshot 1 gallery button. PhotosPicker + Vision, no library permission.

features.name: Result by content type with actions
features.reason: Link, text, Wi-Fi, contact (vCard/MECARD), e-mail, phone, SMS, location, calendar event, product code.

features.name: Link preview before opening
features.reason: Listing 'La sicurezza prima di tutto'. Local only: domain, https, punycode, IP host, shorteners, user@host tricks.

features.reason: Listing 'Esportazione dati in CSV'; folders kept from Sbu Scanner 1.1.
